Normal urchin natural v0.3.0 idle sprite is baked into bank 0 at (64,160,64,64), with source HEX preserved as normal_urchin_idle_00.hex. This asset uses colkey 3; color index 0 is opaque black.
Abnormal urchin v0.4.0 composite sprite is baked into bank 0 at (0,160,64,64), with source HEX parts preserved as abnormal_urchin_*_00.hex.
Environment Wave1 v0.1 source HEX assets are loaded as source_assets, not baked into jack_sprite.pyxres.
Tree extracted v0.2 replaces tree_leafy_a/tree_thin_b source HEX. These tree assets use colkey 8, and color index 0 is visible black.
Equipment extracted v0.2 replaces water_station_* and solar_station_* source HEX. These equipment assets use colkey 8, and color index 0 is visible black.
Equipment and tree sprites use upright_height_billboard_v1. Water station width is adjusted to 36 world units to preserve the 96x128 pixel aspect at 48 world-unit height.
Clean nature v0.3 tall grass uses upright_height_billboard_v1; low grass and small ground details use ground_decal_source_v1 so non-square world sizes can be preserved.
Nature ground detail assets use ground_decal_source_v1 and are projected onto the X/Z ground plane. Ground material tiles are connected only as review surfaces, not full-map tiling.
Ground extracted v0.2 source HEX assets are loaded as source_assets for review surfaces, not baked into jack_sprite.pyxres.

Ground extracted v0.2 concrete base tiles are opaque sources; runtime metadata uses colkey 8 because the current source-asset schema requires an integer colkey and those base sources contain no color index 8.
Ground extracted v0.2 decal sources use colkey 8, and color index 0 is visible black.
Nature clean v0.3 source HEX assets are loaded as source_assets and are preferred for reactive grass and small ground details.
Nature clean v0.3 uses colkey 8 for all six sprites, and color index 0 is visible black.
Grassland direct v0.1 source HEX assets are loaded as source_assets. They are direct extractions from approved images, use colkey 8, and keep color index 0 visible black.

Giant tree roots direct v0.1 source HEX assets are loaded as source_assets. They use colkey 8, keep color index 0 visible black, and are bound as solid obstacle visuals while the existing AABB collision remains authoritative.

Giant tree 02x direct v0.1 source HEX assets are loaded as source_assets. They use colkey 8, keep color index 0 visible black, and are available as solid obstacle visuals while existing AABB collision remains authoritative.

Giant tree roots approved v0.1 source HEX assets supersede the active root/stump obstacle visuals. They are direct approved-image extractions, use colkey 8, keep color index 0 visible black, and retain authored AABB collision as the gameplay source of truth.

Water base tiles v0.1 are 64x64 opaque ground material sources for shallow water tiling. Runtime metadata uses colkey 8 because the current source-asset schema requires an integer colkey and these water sources contain no color index 8.
OFF001 visitor neutral, smile, and half/closed blink assets use the Portrait States Direct v1.0 canonical 64x64 HEX sources with colkey 8.
Jack walk v1 uses the supplied eight-direction swim motion as four-frame exploration locomotion; idle, blink, Water Study, and combat presentation keep their existing assets.
Tree foliage ripple01 replaces the former seven-pose sway with the supplied canonical 65-tick left-to-right leaf ripple; trunk layers, anchors, world sizes, and collision stay unchanged.
